text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali expressed determination to give new impetus to bilateral cooperation with Italy in a message to his Italian counterpart Oscar Luigi Scalfaro on his country's National Day.
- Tunisia aims to speed modernization of the telecommunications sector within the ninth development plan 1997-2001.
- Tunisia to create a new dam "Oued R'mal" by the year 1998 with a capacity of 20 million cubic metres in the southern region of Zaghouan.
- Estimated potato production in the Cap-Bon region is 55,000 tonnes.
- Cooperation and Foreign Investment Minister Mohamed Ghannouchi said 23 investment projects will speed development of the southern region of Gafsa in the near future.
